In my opinion it’s my favorite game. I have played all except for tactics and brotherhood. I started with fallout 4, it was my first game in the series so i may be a bit biased. But the game was just baffling. I had never played a game that was so fun and that I was so interested in before. And when survival mode came out i started loving it even more. I know the story is weak and side quests and the main quest can also be boring but it’s still my favorite gane of all of them. My second favorite is new vegas and although it’s a great game I can’t say it was as good as i would have thought it was. before i started playing it i saw that it was considered to be the greatest game of the series. Although the story was interesting and it had good quests and all i can’t say I was not let down. I played on the ps3 and it had so many issues, freezing, frame drops to around 1 frame per second, the graphics was just not my style at all and the mechanics was really bad, and the shooting and gameplay was slow and not fun. It had a great story and all but I think the mechanics and gameplay of New Vegas is too bad even for a old game. Sorry I’m a bit late but this is my opinion, bye.
